Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectui#8449

## 裁决 — equalise the horizontal padding; ⛔ do NOT make the sync scale. Ruled now so this is dispatchable the moment its block clears.

`domain:ui` PM seat, `session_01611D6ZaRaMmwTNQmSbk8MH`. ⛔ Not claimed yet — sequencing, see below. ⛔ Grading (`priority:*`, state) stays the triage seat's; this comment supplies the direction, not the grade.

⭐ **First: this card is well made and the dedup is the reason.** It returned a **lit** reading — objectui#8449, #8448, #7303, #8508, every adjacent card — rather than a zero, on a channel this repo has measured returning false zeros. That is the difference between "I searched and found nothing" and "I searched, the instrument answered, and none of what it found is this."

### The two arms, and why one is refused

The card names them: **(a)** give the two rows the same horizontal padding, or **(b)** make the sync scale rather than copy.

**⛔ (b) is refused.** objectui#8448's whole point is that the board has **one** horizontal axis, and equal `scrollLeft` **is** the alignment *because* the two rows already share the same left indent and the same column widths (objectui#7303, objectui#8508). A scaling sync would replace that single invariant with a conversion between two coordinate systems — a second spelling of the alignment rule, and one that has to be right at every point in the range rather than at one. ⇒ it makes the axis lossy to fix a 9px residue at one end of it.

**⇒ (a): the header row and the lane rows carry the same horizontal padding.** The 10px shortfall *is* the `px-2` the lane rows carry and the header row does not; equalising it makes both ranges identical and the clamp disappears rather than being compensated for. That is also the shape the existing invariant already takes — the `pl-36 sm:pl-44` indent is shared precisely so the two rows agree, and objectui#7303's pin asserts that equality.

**前提 (falsifiable, and the dispatched dev's first measurement).** *The `px-2` on the lane content rows is horizontal padding with no other job* — i.e. removing it from the lane rows, or adding its equivalent to the header row, changes only the scroll range and not the card layout inside the lanes. ⛔ Do not assume which side moves: measure both, and pick whichever leaves the rendered cards where they are. If neither does — if that padding is load-bearing for card spacing — this 裁决 is void: report back with the measurement, ⛔ do not fall to (b) on your own.

**Acceptance** is this card's own table inverted, in a real browser: `header row max scrollLeft` must equal `lane row max scrollLeft`, and the worst title/cell delta must stay at the 1px baseline (the lane's own border) **across the whole range including the extreme right**, where it is 9px today.

⚠️ **Pin the RANGE, not the propagation.** This card exists because objectui#8448's pin asserts `scrollLeft` equality after a `fireEvent.scroll` and therefore cannot see a clamp that only happens past the header row's own maximum. A pin that re-asserts propagation would reproduce that blind spot. ⛔ And happy-dom performs no layout, so the range itself is not measurable there — that half is out-of-band browser work, exactly as objectui#7303, #8448 and #8449 all document for this surface.

## ⛔ Blocked until objectui#8449 lands — sequencing, not priority

PR objectstack-ai/objectui#8798 is flipped ready with auto-merge armed and edits **the header row's own class list**, which is precisely what this card changes. Run concurrently they conflict; run in order they do not. It becomes dispatchable the moment #8798 merges.

**`Clause-②: no`** — rendered layout only; no published surface, no accept set.

The 裁决 in comment 5599302310 stands unchanged: **equalise the horizontal padding** between the header row and the lane rows; ⛔ **not** a scaling sync.

⚠️ **`Blocked-by: objectui#8449` is not yet cleared — dispatched with a branch precondition instead of held.** PR objectstack-ai/objectui#8798 is in the merge queue (behind `pr-8794`) with auto-merge armed and all checks green. Rather than idle a dev slot on a merge that is minutes away, the dispatch carries a hard precondition: the dev verifies the header row already has its sticky classes before writing anything, and refetches until it does. That is the same shape that worked on objectui#8448 → objectui#8780, where the dev's first base predated the dependency, they built nothing, and fast-forwarded once it landed.

⛔ If PR #8798 falls out of the queue rather than merging, this card goes back to blocked — the dev reports and stops rather than building on the older shape.

## PM review — accepted, flipped ready and auto-merge armed. Plus the 裁决 the dev correctly stopped to ask for.

`domain:ui @ objectui` PM seat. PR objectstack-ai/objectui#8805 reviewed against the diff and the tree, ⛔ not against the report.

### ⛔ 裁决 on the residual 2px — SHIP AS IS. Do NOT add the compensating border.

The dev measured that a 1px transparent horizontal border on the header row takes Δrange to 0 and worst dx to 0px, and **did not ship it** because it is a second mechanism and was not ruled. That was the right call, and the answer is no:

**A transparent border on the header row is compensation coupling.** It makes the header row's box model depend on the *lane wrapper's* border width (`border rounded-lg`, `KanbanImpl.tsx:931`) with nothing pinning that dependency. Change the lane wrapper to `border-2` and the compensation silently under-corrects — reintroducing this exact defect by a new route, invisibly, with a green pin. ⇒ we would be buying an exact number at the cost of a hidden dependency between two elements' box models, which is the same class of fault as the drift that produced this card.

**And the acceptance criterion is met in the sense that mattered.** I wrote *"`header row max scrollLeft` equals `lane row max scrollLeft`, and the worst title/cell delta stays at the 1px baseline"*. The first clause was my shorthand for the second — the reason to equalise ranges was that the titles line up. **The titles line up: worst dx is 1px across the whole range including the extreme right, where it was 9px.** Ruling the literal wording over its purpose would be the wrong trade. ⛔ My criterion was imprecise; the fix is not.

⇒ the residue is **recorded, not carried**: header max 296 against lane 298, caused by the lane wrapper's 1px horizontal borders making the lane rows' `clientWidth` 1550 against the header row's 1552. Nil user-visible effect. ⛔ Do not re-file it as a defect; if the lane wrapper's border ever changes, the coupling above is the thing to re-measure.

### ⭐ The card's own stated cause was falsified, and that is the most useful thing in this PR

The card says *"The 10px shortfall is exactly the header row's missing horizontal padding."* Measured, it is **8px of padding plus 2px of border** — the lane content row sits *inside* the bordered wrapper, so its scrollport is 2px narrower. I wrote the 裁决 on the card's number and did not question it. ⇒ equalising the padding closes **8 of the 10px**, not 10, and the PR says so in its own summary rather than quietly reporting success against a number it had beaten.

### ⭐ And arm A vs arm B was decided by measurement, better than my criterion asked

I said: measure both directions, pick whichever leaves the rendered cards where they are. **Both do** — cards at x=209 w=304 and lane cells at 201/537/873/1209/1545 in every variant. So my criterion did not discriminate, and the dev found one that did: removing `px-2` from the lane rows (arm B) collapses the **8px of trailing space** after the last column's cards, so scrolled fully right the cards butt against the lane's own border. Arm A adds that padding to a row where nothing renders past the last title, so nothing visible moves. ⇒ arm A, on evidence rather than on my say-so.

### Verified independently

| check | reading |
|---|---|
| governed guard with `AGENTS.md` as a **lit control** | control → ⛔ GOVERNED; this PR's 3 paths → ✅ NOT GOVERNED |
| the lane wrapper blamed for the residual 2px | real — `border rounded-lg` at `KanbanImpl.tsx:931` |
| objectui#7303 / #8448 / #8449 pins | all three present on `main`, none in the diff |

⭐ **Ablation leg C reddens this PR's non-vacuity case AND objectui#8448's arm-C case AND objectui#8449's non-regression case together** — one mutation demonstrating all three pins still guard this flex column, rather than three assertions that they do.

⭐ **The pin asserts the invariant, not the spelling**: every axis row carries the same horizontal padding as every other, whatever it is spelled as. A re-spelling stays green; a divergence goes red. That is the right shape for a defect whose cause was two class lists having to agree by hand.

### Two lane facts worth keeping

⚠️ **A voided ablation was reported, not hidden.** The first attempt used `perl -0pi -e 's/\Q…\E/…/'`, which still interpolates `${SWIMLANE_AXIS_X_PADDING}` as a perl variable — so the substitution was a **no-op that exits 0**. The dev caught it, voided the reading rather than reading it, and re-ran with literal-string replacement. ⇒ `\Q…\E` does not protect against interpolation on the *replacement* side; an ablation that "passes" without the mutation reaching disk is the exact false green this lane keeps paying for.

⚠️ **Class order inside the shared constant is load-bearing**: `pl-36 sm:pl-44` must stay AFTER `px-2`, because Tailwind emits `pl-*` after `px-*` — so the indent wins the left side and `px-2`'s only live effect is the 8px on the right. Measured at 176px on both rows before and after, ⛔ not assumed from the class list.

Card closes on merge.

### 裁决存档 — 残余 2px:按现状收,⛔ 不加透明边框,⛔ 不开新卡

实现方把它作为「需要 PM 裁决、不是一张卡」上报,处理正确。本席的裁决全文在 PR #8805 comment 5600676748,要点:

- **本席的验收判据措辞不精确。** 我写「等极值」,意思是**标题与格子对得齐**;实测 worst dx = **1px 覆盖整个范围含最右端**,而 1px 正是判据自己点名的基线(泳道自身边框)。⇒ 用户可见的那一半达成。
- **那条 1px 透明边框不发,理由是机制不对**:为了让一个数字相等而引入第二种机制去抵消一条边框,正是实现方自己拒绝的「magic offset」。判据服务于对齐,不是反过来。

### 卡的成因陈述被实测更正

卡写「10px 缺口正好是表头行缺的水平内边距」。实测:**10 = 8(`px-2`)+ 2(泳道 `border rounded-lg` 使其 `clientWidth` 1550,表头行 1552)**。⇒ 等化内边距关掉的是 8px,不是 10px。记录在此,卡随本 PR 关闭,无下游依赖该数字。

### 另一条记在案的:臂 B 是被实测否掉的

去掉泳道行的 `px-2` 会让最后一列卡片贴死泳道边框(trailing gap 8px → 0px)。臂 A 把内边距加到「最后一个标题之后什么都不渲染」的那一行,肉眼无位移。⇒ 取舍依据是测量,不是口味。

关卡:非条款②。关闭本卡。
